name: resonant-hunt
scope: Five original adaptive score arrangements; spatial, occluded combat sound; independent audio buses and quiet mix; tracked palm familiar; physical crossbow reload and pickup pull; controller-operated bounded slow-time quiver; ricochet arrows and permanent Mirror Thread unlock. Preserves Hollow Dominions, Xbox, VR and stationary AR Sanctuary.
saveCompatibility: Existing vesperfall-profile-v1, renown, purchases, Chronicle rewards and AR-suspended expeditions are preserved. New hit totals start at zero when absent.
hardwareStatus: Software browser and emulated-controller acceptance are used for publication. Real Quest 3 controller ergonomics, comfort, audio localization and performance still require physical hardware playtesting.
